mechanisms.controller: monotone pure pursuit and bounded speed servo; gap feedback for trucks; reverse gear controller for backing
unconfirmed: No CARLA execution: spawn inventory, road import, collision/departure, controller tracking and camera visibility unverified.
Mandatory raw atom streams are implemented only for direct telemetry; remaining atom projections require completion against retained original-frame PipelineCapture evidence.
Primary encoded review videos are not implemented; runner saves four synchronized original RGB PNG sequences and exact frame map.
Distinctly marked rendered crosswalk, residence-district setting and statutory region extents are authored draft context; native/rendered crosswalk realization is not implemented.
Crosswalk footprint intersection projection and native highway boundary checks require completion; backing telemetry alone does not establish overlap.

measurement_plan.source: original-frame PipelineCapture + actor telemetry; never requested targets as observation
measurement_plan.finalization: finalize.py recomputes explicit frozen time-window/statistic from saved channel streams. Before acceptance implement all mandatory atom projections, verify native setup/cause, encode full-trace videos, compare targets and frame mapping; physical sweeps remain incomplete until feasible range frozen.

termination_rules.completion: native route final point reached within 2m engineering tolerance
termination_rules.cleanup: stop/destroy owned sensors and actors; close recorder/capture; restore saved world settings; never stop simulator server
termination_rules.failures: nonzero code 2 for any unresolved setup, target, physical, capture or video requirement
